description: This file contains a library of functions to format test scripts' output in JUnit XML format for integration with CI/CD systems like Azure Pipelines. It defines functions to start and finalize test output, handle individual test cases, and encode XML attributes, primarily for generating structured test reports from shell scripts.

methods.name: start_test_output
methods.description: Initializes the JUnit XML output file for a given test script, creating directories, and writing the opening tags.

methods.name: start_test_case_output
methods.description: Records the start time of an individual test case.

methods.name: finalize_test_case_output
methods.description: Finalizes the output for an individual test case, recording its result and appending appropriate XML tags.

methods.name: finalize_test_output
methods.description: Closes the overall test report, updates time attributes, and finalizes the XML document.

methods.name: write_junit_xml
methods.description: Writes XML content to the JUnit XML file, optionally truncating the file.

methods.name: xml_attr_encode
methods.description: Encodes a string for safe inclusion as an XML attribute, handling special characters.
